ABOUT.TITLE: Built for flexible city living
ABOUT.BODY: HomeStay Dorm combines branch discovery, student-friendly housing, and a guided booking journey into one calm experience. The homepage introduces each branch the way the Figma fullpage screen intended: cinematic first, practical second.

CARD_ONE.TITLE: Explore branches
CARD_ONE.BODY: Use the hero search and branch slider to quickly compare locations before moving into detail pages.

CARD_TWO.TITLE: Review the process
CARD_TWO.BODY: Navigation is designed to guide visitors from discovery to room detail, booking, and later account actions.

CARD_THREE.TITLE: Switch language anytime
CARD_THREE.BODY: The globe menu keeps English and Vietnamese available directly from the hero navigation.

CONTACT.TITLE: Need help choosing a branch?
CONTACT.BODY: Talk with the HomeStay Dorm team if you want guidance on location, room type, or the next booking step.
